literal: Xiao Daocheng's inspector of Yuzhou Yuan Chongzu raided Xiakai; Prince of Changli Feng Xi defeated them.
idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng's inspector of Yuzhou, Yuan Chongzu, raided Xiakai; Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, defeated them.

literal: Acting Prince of Liangjun Jia greatly defeated Daocheng's generals, captured more than thirty thousand mouths, and sent them to the capital.
idiomatic: Acting Prince of Liangjun Jia routed Daocheng's generals, took more than thirty thousand captives, and sent them to the capital.

literal: Third month, day xinyou first of month: the imperial carriage traveled to Sizhou.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, the new moon, the emperor went to Sizhou.

literal: Day guihai: held a military review on the south bank of Yunshui.
idiomatic: On the guihai day he held a military review on the south bank of Yunshui.

literal: Wherever he passed, he examined prefects and magistrates and promoted or demoted them.
idiomatic: Wherever he passed he examined prefects and magistrates and promoted or demoted them.

literal: Day jisi: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the jisi day the court returned to the palace.

literal: An edict stated: "Faxiu by demonic fraud disturbed the norm, falsely spoke of omens and portents; Orchid Terrace Censor Zhang Qiu and more than a hundred others recruited slaves and plotted great treason. The offices judged them for clan extermination—truly fitting the penal statutes.
idiomatic: An edict stated, "The monk Faxiu disturbed the norm through demonic fraud and falsely spoke of omens and portents. Orchid Terrace censor Zhang Qiu and more than a hundred others recruited slaves and plotted great treason. The offices judged them for clan extermination—truly fitting the penal statutes.

literal: Yet to pity the foolish and value life, [13] is what we still cannot bear.
idiomatic: Yet to pity the foolish and value life [13] is what we still cannot bear.

literal: For the five clans, reduce to the same great-grandfather;
idiomatic: For the five clans, reduce punishment to the same great-grandfather;

literal: for the three clans, stop at one gate;
idiomatic: for the three clans, stop at one gate;

literal: for gate execution, stop at the person alone."
idiomatic: for gate execution, stop at the person alone."

literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiazi: Xiao Daocheng sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiazi day, Xiao Daocheng sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day xinyou: a separate Rouran commander, Taji, led his band inward in submission.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day a separate Rouran commander, Taji, led his band in submission.

literal: Day jiaxu: promulgated five articles on relief households, mixed dependents, and household registers.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day five articles on relief households, mixed dependents, and household registers were promulgated.

literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: reviewed troops at the southern suburb and gave a great feast to the assembled ministers.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengzi day, troops were reviewed at the southern suburb and the assembled ministers were given a great feast.

literal: Xiao Daocheng sent Che Senglang; because his place in the seating order came after Yin Lingdan, envoy of Liu Zhun, he declined and would not take his seat.
idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng sent Che Senglang; because his place in the seating order came after Yin Lingdan, Liu Zhun's envoy, he declined and would not take his seat.

literal: Xie Fengjun, a man of Liu Zhun who had surrendered, stabbed Senglang amid the assembly.
idiomatic: Xie Fengjun, a man of Liu Zhun who had surrendered, stabbed Senglang amid the assembly.

literal: An edict ordered the execution of Fengjun and others.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the execution of Fengjun and others.

literal: Day yihai: Feng Xi's heir, Prince of Changli, Dan, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.
idiomatic: On the yihai day Dan, heir of Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

literal: Yanzhou beheaded Sima Langzhi and sent the head to the capital.
idiomatic: Yanzhou beheaded Sima Langzhi and sent the head to the capital.

literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guimao day, the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: an edict that twelve provinces and garrisons had famished people; granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, an edict stated that twelve provinces and garrisons had famished people; granaries were opened for relief.

literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day jiaxu: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on the jiaxu day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Second month, day xinmao, an edict stated: "Lingqiu commandery's soil is cramped and poor, and it lies on routes between provinces; public and private passage entails no small expense. On last year's tour I saw its toil and exhaustion; the people's rent and levies may be remitted for fifteen years.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinmao day, an edict stated, "Lingqiu commandery's soil is cramped and poor, and it lies on routes between provinces; public and private passage entails no small expense. On last year's tour I saw its toil and exhaustion; the people's rent and levies may be remitted for fifteen years.

literal: " Day guisi: Prince of Bailan, Tuyuhun Yishi, was executed for false accusation.
idiomatic: " On the guisi day Prince of Bailan, Tuyuhun Yishi, was executed for false accusation.

literal: Day yiwei, an edict stated: "Xiao Daocheng rebelled and threw the Jiang-Huai into disorder; battle banners were raised again and again. The people of seven provinces already bear the labor of transport for campaigns—deeply at odds with the principle of light levies. We are deeply moved with pity.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict stated, "Xiao Daocheng rebelled and threw the Jiang-Huai into disorder; battle banners were raised again and again. The people of seven provinces already bear the labor of transport for campaigns—deeply at odds with the principle of light levies. We are deeply moved with pity.

literal: Let the regular levies be remitted for three years.
idiomatic: Let the regular levies be remitted for three years.

literal: " Day wushen: the state of Dadouyu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: " On the wushen day the state of Dadouyu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day guichou: princes, dukes, and those below who were noted for purity and diligence were given grain and cloth in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On the guichou day princes, dukes, and officials below them who were noted for purity and diligence were given grain and cloth in differing amounts.

literal: Third month, day gengchen: traveled to the Tiger Park; an edict stated: "Tigers and wolves are fierce and cruel, eating flesh and destroying life. On the days of capture there are always many injuries; since there is no benefit and the waste is great, from now on do not again present captured beasts as tribute.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengchen day, he went to the Tiger Park. An edict stated, "Tigers and wolves are fierce and cruel, eating flesh and destroying life. On capture days there are always many injuries; since there is no benefit and the waste is great, from now on do not again present captured beasts as tribute.

literal: " Day xinsi: visited the cave-temple on Mount Wuzhou and gave clothing to the aged poor.
idiomatic: " On the xinsi day he visited the cave-temple on Mount Wuzhou and gave clothing to the aged poor.

literal: Day renwu: visited Mount Fang.
idiomatic: On the renwu day he visited Mount Fang.

literal: That month Xiao Daocheng died; his son Ze usurped the throne.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Daocheng died; his son Ze usurped the throne.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: within the capital region, widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were given grain and cloth in differing amounts.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiachen day, within the capital region widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were given grain and cloth in differing amounts.

literal: Sixth month: the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month: fifty thousand men from provinces and commanderies were levied to work on the Lingqiu road.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn fifty thousand men from provinces and commanderies were levied to work on the Lingqiu road.

literal: Eighth month, day guimao first of month: envoys great and small were dispatched separately to tour places throughout the realm that had suffered flood; the people's rent and levies were remitted, and those poor and unable to support themselves [15] were given grain and cloth.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guimao day, the new moon, great and small envoys were dispatched separately to tour places throughout the realm that had suffered flood; the people's rent and levies were remitted, and those poor and unable to support themselves [15] were given grain and cloth.

literal: Day gengzi: the prohibition on mountains and marshes was lifted.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day the prohibition on mountains and marshes was lifted.

literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: the Di chieftain Yang Houqi was made Prince of Wudu.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinyou day, the Di chieftain Yang Houqi was made Prince of Wudu.

literal: Winter, eleventh month, day yimao: the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the yimao day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Twelfth month, day dinghai, an edict stated: "We are meager and slight; government lacks peace and harmony and cannot look up to align the celestial signs and avert these six calamities.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dinghai day, an edict stated, "We are meager and slight; government lacks peace and harmony and cannot look up to align the celestial signs and avert these six calamities.

literal: Last autumn's excessive rain brought flood disaster; the people cried out—We sighed with pity and therefore sent envoys to tour the regions and give relief.
idiomatic: Last autumn's excessive rain brought flood disaster; the people cried out—we sighed with pity and therefore sent envoys to tour the regions and give relief.

literal: Yet the prefects and shepherds did not think of ways to benefit the people but aimed only to collect and finish.
idiomatic: Yet the prefects and shepherds did not think of ways to benefit the people but aimed only to collect and finish.

literal: To cherish the fur and turn against the hide—how very pointless.
idiomatic: To cherish the fur and turn against the hide—how very pointless.

literal: Now all levies not yet entered and all future rent assessments are entirely remitted.
idiomatic: Now all levies not yet entered and all future rent assessments are entirely remitted.

literal: Let the offices strive to encourage collection so as to secure next year's abundance—this accords with Our intent."
idiomatic: Let the offices strive to encourage collection so as to secure next year's abundance—this accords with our intent."

literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day gengshen, an edict stated: "We constantly think to know the people's hardships so as to increase and repair lenient government, yet Our clarity does not illumine what is far—truly there are gaps.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on the gengshen day, an edict stated, "We constantly think to know the people's hardships so as to increase and repair lenient government, yet our clarity does not illumine what is far—truly there are gaps.

literal: Therefore We fully questioned provincial and commandery envoys, recommended filial sons, and review clerks about the harsh and cruel conduct of prefects and magistrates, yet the replies were mostly untrue—greatly at odds with Our intent in earnestly seeking truth.
idiomatic: Therefore we fully questioned provincial and commandery envoys, recommended filial sons, and review clerks about the harsh and cruel conduct of prefects and magistrates, yet the replies were mostly untrue—greatly at odds with our intent in earnestly seeking truth.

literal: They ought to be judged by the great capital statute, making clear that deceiving the throne must be punished.
idiomatic: They ought to be judged by the great capital statute, making clear that deceiving the throne must be punished.

literal: Yet Our feeling still cannot bear it; they may be pardoned of crime and allowed to return.
idiomatic: Yet our feeling still cannot bear it; they may be pardoned of crime and allowed to return.

literal: Proclaim this below to all under Heaven so that all know later offenses will not be pardoned.
idiomatic: Proclaim this below to all under Heaven so that all know later offenses will not be pardoned.

literal: " Day dingmao: an edict that the people of Qing, Qi, Guang, and Eastern Xu provinces, each household transporting twenty shi of granary grain [16] to Xiaqiu and Langye, would have rent assessments remitted for one year.
idiomatic: " On the dingmao day an edict stated that the people of Qing, Qi, Guang, and Eastern Xu provinces, each household transporting twenty shi of granary grain [16] to Xiaqiu and Langye, would have rent assessments remitted for one year.

literal: Third month, day jiaxu: because the people of Ji and Ding provinces were famished, an edict ordered commanderies and counties to set out porridge on the roads to feed them, and also relaxed prohibitions at passes and fords, allowing free coming and going.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiaxu day, because the people of Ji and Ding provinces were famished, an edict ordered commanderies and counties to set out porridge on the roads to feed them, and also relaxed prohibitions at passes and fords, allowing free coming and going.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengzi: visited Mount Guo and gave clothing, grain, and cloth to widowers and widows along the route who could not support themselves.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, he visited Mount Guo and gave clothing, grain, and cloth to widowers and widows along the route who could not support themselves.

literal: Day renyin: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the renyin day the court returned to the palace.

literal: Intercalary month, day guichou: an imperial son was born; a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the guichou day, an imperial son was born and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Fifth month, day wuyin first of month: visited the cave Buddhist temple on Mount Wuzhou.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, the new moon, he visited the cave Buddhist temple on Mount Wuzhou.

literal: Sixth month: Ding province reported that porridge was given to the famished; those kept alive numbered more than 947,000 mouths.
idiomatic: In the sixth month Ding province reported that porridge was given to the famished; those kept alive numbered more than 947,000 mouths.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingchou: the Emperor and the Empress Dowager visited the Divine Abyss Pool.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingchou day, the emperor and the empress dowager visited the Divine Abyss Pool.

literal: Day jiashen: visited Mount Fang.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day he visited Mount Fang.

literal: An edict made Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Li Biao and Outer Office Member Lanying envoys to Xiao Ze.
idiomatic: An edict made Li Biao, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, and Lanying, outer office member, envoys to Xiao Ze.

literal: Prince of Jinan Luoba was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao commandery.
idiomatic: Prince of Jinan Luoba was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao commandery.

literal: Ninth month, day renyin, an edict stated: "We inherit the ancestors, fearful day and night, yet in the intervals of hearing government We still worry it is not complete; as to examining documents and trying cases, We wish to hear Our faults.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renyin day, an edict stated, "We inherit the ancestors, fearful day and night, yet in the intervals of hearing government we still worry it is not complete; as to examining documents and trying cases, we wish to hear our faults.

literal: From now on when the assembled officials present affairs, they should offer what is acceptable and replace what is not—none may agree to Our face, so that Our faults may be made manifest near and far.
idiomatic: From now on when the assembled officials present affairs, they should offer what is acceptable and replace what is not—none may agree to our face, so that our faults may be made manifest near and far.

literal: " Ji province reported that porridge was given to famished people; those kept alive numbered more than 751,700 mouths.
idiomatic: " Ji province reported that porridge was given to famished people; those kept alive numbered more than 751,700 mouths.

literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuwu: the Imperial Trust Hall was completed.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the wuwu day, the Imperial Trust Hall was completed.

literal: Eleventh month, day xinchou: Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinchou day, Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Twelfth month, day guichou, an edict stated: "Pure custom flourished in high antiquity; ritual transformation was employed in recent ages.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guichou day, an edict stated, "Pure custom flourished in high antiquity; ritual transformation was employed in recent ages.

literal: Thus Xia and Yin did not shrink from marriage within one clan; the Zhou age first ended marriage between those of the same surname.
idiomatic: Thus Xia and Yin did not shrink from marriage within one clan; the Zhou age first ended marriage between those of the same surname.

literal: These were all teachings set according to the times and government changed with affairs.
idiomatic: These were all teachings set according to the times and government changed with affairs.

literal: When the imperial fortune was first founded the central plains were not yet united; in settling disorder and ordering the realm there was no leisure day by day; ancient custom and surviving simplicity were not yet rectified, and later it was followed as precedent until now without change.
idiomatic: When the imperial fortune was first founded the central plains were not yet united; in settling disorder and ordering the realm there was no leisure day by day; ancient custom and surviving simplicity were not yet rectified, and later it was followed as precedent until now without change.

literal: We stand in the period of a hundred years and ought to enact humane government hereafter; We think to change the substance of the old and make the renewal manifest.
idiomatic: We stand in the period of a hundred years and ought to enact humane government hereafter; we think to change the substance of the old and make the renewal manifest.

literal: From now on let it all be utterly forbidden; violators are to be judged by the statute of impiety.
idiomatic: From now on let it all be utterly forbidden; violators are to be judged by the statute of impiety.

literal: " Day gengwu: the prohibition on Mount Linlü was opened and shared with the people.
idiomatic: " On the gengwu day the prohibition on Mount Linlü was opened and shared with the people.

literal: An edict that thirteen provinces and garrisons had famished people; granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: An edict stated that thirteen provinces and garrisons had famished people; granaries were opened for relief.

literal: Eighth year, spring, first month: an edict made Yuan Chen of Longxi and Minister of the Masters of Writing Lu Rui great envoys of the eastern and western routes to praise the good and punish the evil.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the eighth year an edict made Yuan Chen of Longxi and Lu Rui, Minister of the Masters of Writing, great envoys of the eastern and western routes to praise the good and punish the evil.

literal: Second month: the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the second month the state of Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin: visited Mount Fang.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiayin day, he visited Mount Fang.

literal: Day wuwu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day the court returned to the palace.

literal: Day gengshen: traveled to Xuanhong Pool, then visited Mount Guo.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day he traveled to Xuanhong Pool, then visited Mount Guo.

literal: Day dingmao: returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day he returned to the palace.

literal: Fifth month, day jimao: an edict gave relief gifts to garrison soldiers of the seven Henan provinces.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jimao day, an edict gave relief gifts to garrison soldiers of the seven Henan provinces.

literal: Day jiashen: an edict made Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Li Biao and Outer Office Member Lanying envoys to Xiao Ze.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day an edict made Li Biao, palace attendant of scattered cavalry, and Lanying, outer office member, envoys to Xiao Ze.

literal: Sixth month, day dingmao, an edict stated: "Establishing offices and ranking salaries has long been practiced.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingmao day, an edict stated, "Establishing offices and ranking salaries has long been practiced.

literal: The Rites of Zhou have the canon of food-salary; the two Han dynasties set the ranks of receiving stipends.
idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou have the canon of food-salary; the two Han dynasties set the ranks of receiving stipends.

literal: Down to Wei and Jin, none failed to follow former statutes to order the realm.
idiomatic: Down to Wei and Jin, none failed to follow former statutes to order the realm.

literal: Since the central plains fell into disorder this system was cut off midstream; the former court followed precedent and had no leisure to rectify it.
idiomatic: Since the central plains fell into disorder this system was cut off midstream; the former court followed precedent and had no leisure to rectify it.

literal: We eternally mirror the four quarters and seek the people's sores, rising early and awaiting dawn unto anxious toil.
idiomatic: We eternally mirror the four quarters and seek the people's sores, rising early and awaiting dawn unto anxious toil.

literal: Therefore We take the old canon as law and first promulgate salaries.
idiomatic: Therefore we take the old canon as law and first promulgate salaries.

literal: Merchant offices are abolished to simplify the people's affairs.
idiomatic: Merchant offices are abolished to simplify the people's affairs.

literal: Each household has an added levy of three bolts and two hu nine dou of grain for official salaries.
idiomatic: Each household has an added levy of three bolts and two hu nine dou of grain for official salaries.

literal: The average advance levy as a two-bolt assessment [17] also serves commercial use.
idiomatic: The average advance levy as a two-bolt assessment [17] also serves commercial use.

literal: Though there is temporary trouble for a time, in the end the benefit of lasting ease is achieved.
idiomatic: Though there is temporary trouble for a time, in the end the benefit of lasting ease is achieved.

literal: After salaries are implemented, corruption reaching one bolt is death.
idiomatic: After salaries are implemented, corruption reaching one bolt is death.

literal: To change law and alter measures ought to be a fresh beginning; a general amnesty throughout the realm shares renewal with it.
idiomatic: To change law and alter measures ought to be a fresh beginning; a general amnesty throughout the realm shares renewal with it.

literal: " Day wuchen: Wuzhou waters overflowed and destroyed people's dwellings.
idiomatic: " On the wuchen day Wuzhou waters overflowed and destroyed people's dwellings.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiwei: traveled to the cave-temple on Mount Fang.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yiwei day, he traveled to the cave-temple on Mount Fang.

literal: Eighth month, day jiachen, an edict stated: "The imperial enterprise is supremely weighty; without broad consultation governance cannot be attained;
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiachen day, an edict stated, "The imperial enterprise is supremely weighty; without broad consultation governance cannot be attained;

literal: kingly affairs are supremely numerous; without wide collection achievement cannot be raised.
idiomatic: kingly affairs are supremely numerous; without wide collection achievement cannot be raised.

literal: The former kings knew it was thus; therefore they emptied themselves to seek faults and used clear forbearance to reflect on blame.
idiomatic: The former kings knew it was thus; therefore they emptied themselves to seek faults and used clear forbearance to reflect on blame.
